goal: Enable hardware-accelerated SHA256 implementations for MSVC builds on Windows
Eliminate severe hashing performance penalties for developers building with MSVC
agreement: Blocking objection: adds MSVC code contrary to project direction to drop MSVC for clang-cl (fanquake)
Verified 5x to 10x faster SHA256 benchmark performance on Intel i9 (sipsorcery)
Verified speed improvements on Windows 11 with VS2022 (m3dwards)
Concept approval because it lays groundwork for other instruction sets (laanwj)
Concept approval noting changes look uncontroversial modulo verifying cpuid logic (theuni)
